svg.text: H₂ crosses the membrane wall from the catalyst annulus into the bore
(a) Longitudinal section, co-current: sweep gas enters at z = 0
(b) Longitudinal section, counter-current: sweep gas enters at z = L
Retentate in the catalyst annulus: CO, H₂O, CO₂, H₂, CH₄, N₂
H₂ permeating through the membrane wall
Permeate stream in the bore: H₂, plus sweep gas if used
Catalyst particles: size to scale, packing illustrative
Annulus: catalyst bed and retentate gas;
Bore: permeate H₂, plus sweep gas if used
area 162 cm² (π × OD × length), annulus volume 235 cm³
Geometry follows the Hla (2015) template in the model register; the shell ID of 25.4 mm (1 in) is assumed. Membrane OD and length are register values.
Permeate inside the tube is the model’s assumption, not confirmed for the H2Site rig. EBRI, Aston University.
